name: aes_inverse_scan
description: Find AES-128 and AES-256 schedules stored as a decryption routine keeps them (InvMixColumns on the middle rounds, rounds in forward or reverse order, word bytes as they are or reversed) in a file or memory image, at every byte alignment. Each whole, checked schedule's original key goes to a private file in out_dir, never to the answer; the answer gives offset, layout, key size and the key's sha256. A hit is a lead. Not AES-192, not the plain layout (aes_schedule_scan). Windows through start, length and budget_seconds.

path.description: The file or memory image to scan (read only)

out_dir.description: Where the key files and the whole result go, inside the run directory and not under inputs/ (default work/<agent>/aes_inverse_scan)

start.description: First byte to test (default 0). A schedule is reported by where it starts, so successive windows never lose or double one

length.description: How many bytes to test from start (default: to the end of the file)

budget_seconds.description: Stop at a chunk boundary after this long and say complete=false with next_start; call again with start=next_start (default 240)
